notes: Next.js (RSC) site, NOT Shopify - no /collections.json. Two independent exact sources were used and agreed on every category: (1) the server-rendered listing footer 'Showing 1-20 of N products', and (2) full enumeration via ?limit=1000, which server-renders the entire listing; product cards counted by their unique RSC marker. All 7 categories large enough to paginate matched exactly (143/108/310/65/21/34/62). Independent third check: each 'View All' parent total equals the sum of its children - Wall 328 = Sconces 310 + Picture Lights 10 + Spot Lights 8; Ceiling 27 = 18+8+1; Outdoor 124 = 11+34+11+62+6; Accessories 62 = 13+15+12(holders)+17(spares)+5(switches). EXCLUDED: /wall, /ceiling and /outdoor parents (their H1 is literally 'View All Wall/Ceiling/Outdoor' - view-all nav pages, and including them would double-count the leaves); /lamps + /lamps/filament + /lamps/led (bulbs); /accessories/holders (bulb holders/adaptors), /accessories/switches, /accessories/accessories-spares (cables, power supplies, pipes, screwdrivers) and the /accessories parent as electrical components/hardware; /one-eva (69) as a brand/collection line; /sale, /online-store, /concepts as marketing pages. DROPPED as genuinely 0 products: /festive-lights/diwali, /lamps/incandescent, /concepts. /bath (4) kept - it is a vanity/mirror WALL LIGHT range, i.e. lighting fixtures, not bathroom products. Note the XML sitemap lists many discontinued product URLs (e.g. ~15 under /bath) that no longer appear in any listing; counts come from the live listings, not the sitemap.
